question: What attraction can I find within 40 kilometers ahead of Memory Garden, Baltimore, MD toward National Firearms Museum, Fairfax, VA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.335576 38.862953)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'attraction'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography, 40000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Scott’s Cove at Rocky Gorge Reservoir

poi.description: Established by Ms. Justine Bonner. Maintained by Ms. Hannah Trent and the Sandtown South Neighborhood Alliance. A mural in this location depicts Ms. Bonner, Ms. Trent, and Ms. Sandra Smith. The mural was painted by local artist Justin Nethercut.
